title: Add the keyword DANCE to your Seedance 2.0 prompt to turn a single portrait…
content: Add the keyword DANCE to your Seedance 2.0 prompt to turn a single portrait photo into a street-dance music video while keeping the same face, hair, and style locked.
tips: Add the keyword DANCE to your Seedance 2.0 prompt to turn a single portrait photo into a street-dance music video while keeping the same face, hair, and style locked.

es.content:
---
Añade la palabra clave DANCE a tu prompt de Seedance 2.0 para convertir una sola foto de retrato en un video musical de street-dance mientras mantienes el mismo rostro, cabello y estilo.

--- CONTINUACIÓN DEL HILO ---
[Hilo 1] Tu foto, tu MV, tu momento.
---

fr.content:
---
Ajoutez le mot-clé DANCE à votre prompt Seedance 2.0 pour transformer une seule photo portrait en un clip vidéo de street-dance tout en conservant le même visage, les mêmes cheveux et le même style.

--- SUITE DU FIL ---
[Fil 1] Votre photo, votre clip, votre moment.
---

ja.content:
---

--- スレッドの続き ---
[スレッド1] あなたの写真、あなたのMV、あなたの瞬間。
---

ko.content:
---
Seedance 2.0 프롬프트에 키워드 DANCE를 추가하여 단일 인물 사진을 거리 춤 음악 비디오로 변환하면서 얼굴, 머리 스타일, 스타일을 그대로 유지하세요.

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] 당신의 사진, 당신의 MV, 당신의 순간.
---

pt.content:
Adicione a palavra-chave DANCE ao seu prompt do Seedance 2.0 para transformar uma única foto de retrato em um videoclipe de street dance, mantendo o mesmo rosto, cabelo e estilo fixos.

--- CONTINUAÇÃO DO TÓPICO ---
[Tópico 1] Sua foto, seu videoclipe, seu momento.

zh.content:
